cast.name: Stevens
cast.role: Head butler of Darlington Hall devoted entirely to professional dignity
cast.look: A severe 50-year-old English butler, slender upright posture, slicked greying hair, wearing a spotless black tailcoat vest and crisp collar.

cast.name: Lord Darlington
cast.role: Aristocratic English lord who falls into naive appeasement with Nazi Germany
cast.look: A distinguished 60-year-old British nobleman with receding silver hair, tailored tweed and wool morning suit, holding a silver pocket watch.

cast.name: Mr. Faraday
cast.role: Wealthy American gentleman who buys Darlington Hall after the war
cast.look: A relaxed 55-year-old American businessman with casual posture, open-collar linen suit, relaxed smile and neat salt-and-pepper hair.

cast.name: Miss Kenton
cast.role: Head housekeeper at Darlington Hall whose warmth and affection Stevens represses
cast.look: A sensible 40-year-old English housekeeper with observant warm eyes, dark hair tied in a practical chignon, wearing an austere dark wool dress with white apron.

cast.name: Dr. Meredith
cast.role: Local estate physician attending to Stevens' dying father
cast.look: A quiet 50-year-old provincial British doctor in a dark Victorian-cut frock coat, spectacles, carrying a leather medical bag.
